name: Test two causes for the same observable result

uses.action: Build a tap from a stored drop, then make the same sound with a direct squeeze at the cloakroom hatch.
Reproduce a four-beat sound in the theatre stalls while changing the hand and gesture that cause the tap.

name: Compare a written cue with the performance it permits

uses.action: Issue the quiet rail’s score after watching the worker and listening at the hatch. The visiting company receives the score and billing.
Write the foyer’s rain part, check what visitors can hear, then issue a version that gives the keeper a bow or the stage.
